name: Logitech
summary: Mouse controls and optional keyboard connection, battery and Easy-Switch events.
capabilities: Runs the selected OpenLogi application's agent-backed control commands
Reads device status, battery, supported DPI and wheel settings
Applies explicitly requested temporary settings and checks read-back
Exports reviewed DPI and wheel actions through the shared plugin SDK
Publishes only fresh changes from the selected keyboard when its watch is enabled; no typing capture or startup replay
Enables the selected keyboard host-button watch through OpenLogi and publishes only fresh channel choices; does not divert typing or change hosts
